REGULAR MEETING
OF THE
CITY COUNCIL AND
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - FEBRUARY 28, 2013 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
A G E N D A
Public input will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered.
1.
Call to Order
2.
Invocation
3.
Pledge of Allegiance
4.
Roll Call
5.
Presentations
6.
Public Comments and Suggestions
CONSENT CALENDAR
7.
Approval of Registers of Demands
A.
City of Cerritos dated February 28, 2013. (COUNCIL)
approve the Register of Demands dated February 28, 2013 in the total amount of $5,942,862.86.
8.
Approval of Minutes
A.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting of February 14, 2013. (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
approve the City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of February 14, 2013.
End of Consent Calendar
9.
Public Hearing Notices
A.
Consideration to waive reading of and introduce AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS AMENDING CHAPTER 5.22, MASSAGE ESTABLISHMENTS, AND CHAPTER 22.12, DEVELOPMENT AREA TWO, OF THE CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE AS THEY RELATE TO THE REGULATION OF MASSAGE ESTABLISHMENTS. (COUNCIL)
DEVELOPMENT CODE AMENDMENT 2013-1*
*PURSUANT TO SECTION 15061(B)(3) OF THE CALIFORNIA ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT (CEQA), THIS PROJECT IS EXEMPT FROM CEQA REVIEW.
1. Review and discuss the proposed development code amendment and conduct a public hearing;
2. Approve Development Code Amendment 2013-1, making the findings set forth in the Cerritos Planning Commission Resolution No. PC 2013-1; and
3. Waive reading of and introduce an ordinance amending Chapter 5.22, Massage Establishments, and Chapter 22.12, Development Area Two, of the Cerritos Municipal Code, as set forth in Development Code Amendment 2013-1, captioned:
AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS AMENDING CHAPTER 5.22, MASSAGE ESTABLISHMENTS, AND CHAPTER 22.12, DEVELOPMENT AREA TWO, OF THE CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE AS THEY RELATE TO THE REGULATION OF MASSAGE ESTABLISHMENTS.
10.
New and Old Business
A.
Consideration and award of a contract for the Cerritos Park East restroom rehabilitation, Project No. 12795, Bid No. 1155-13. (COUNCIL)
award a contract in the amount of $169,950 to Cinbad Industry, Inc. for the Cerritos Park East Restroom Rehabilitation, Project No. 12795, Bid No. 155-13, and reject all other bids.
B.
Consideration and adoption of the Recognized Obligation Payment Schedule Workbook ("ROPS 13-14A") of the Successor Agency to the Cerritos Redevelopment Agency for the period beginning July 1, 2013 to conform with Health and Safety Code Sections 34167(h) and 34169(g), in compliance with Assembly Bill 1X 26 and Assembly Bill 1484. (SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
1. Receive and file this report;
2. Waive reading of and adopt the attached resolution, entitled: A RESOLUTION OF THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY ADOPTING THE RECOGNIZED OBLIGATION PAYMENT SCHEDULE WORKBOOK ("ROPS 13-14A") FOR THE PERIOD BEGINNIG JULY 1, 2013, IN COMPLIANCE WITH THE PROVISIONS OF AB 1X 26 AND AB 1484;
3. After adoption, authorize staff to transmit the adopted ROPS 13-14A workbook to all appropriate regulatory and oversight agencies as requried by AB 1X 26 ad AB 1484; and
4. Authorize staff to implement all actions necessary to fulfill all notification and posting requirements as required by AB 1X 26 and AB 1484.
11.
Legislative Items
A.
Report on Pending Legislation.
B.
Action to support or oppose specific legislation pending in the California Legislature or pending in the California Governor's Office for signature.
1.
Consideration to waive reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS TO SUPPORT AB 741(BROWN) TO ADD SECTION 98.3 TO THE CALIFORNIA REVENUE AND TAXATION CODE WHICH PROPOSES TO ENSURE THAT QUALIFYING CITIES RECEIVE A MINIMUM AMOUNT OF AD VALOREM PROPERTY TAX REVENUES NECESSARY TO MAINTAIN SERVICES. (COUNCIL)
1. Waive reading and adopt the attached resolution entitled: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS TO SUPPORT AB 741 (BROWN) TO ADD SECTION 98.3 TO THE CALIFORNIA REVENUE AND TAXATION CODE WHICH PROPOSES TO ENSURE THAT QUALIFYING CITIES RECEIVE A MINMUM AMOUNT OF AD VALOREM PROPERTY TAX REVENUES NECESSARY TO MAINTAIN SERVICES.
2. Direct staff to continue to work ith our legislative advocates in Sacramento to seek support and approval from the California Legislature, as well as other cities, counties and associations to request the signature of Governer Brown for AB 741.
12.
City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings
13.
Adjournment
